C9000200.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 200 (Eisenbud–Green–Harris and lex-plus-powers.; papers: The Artinian Lex-Plus-Powers Betti Theorem; Commuting Division-Coefficient Forms and the Artinian Eisenbud--Green--Harris Conjecture; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_EGH_CONSTRUCTION.statement: The commuting-form construction theorem supplies division coefficients, triangular power identities, and a left-division-algebra basis of the full polynomial algebra.

C_EGH_MAIN.statement: The EGH manuscript claims the pure-powers Hilbert-function comparison in characteristic zero for regular sequences of every positive length.

C_LPP_MAIN.statement: The companion manuscript claims a single lex-plus-powers ideal with the same Hilbert function and all graded Betti numbers at least those of the given ideal, over every characteristic-zero field.

C_EGH_LOW_RELATIONS.statement: The low-relation induction yields the multiplicity-one-factor hypothesis required by the parameter theorem.

C_EGH_ASSEMBLY.statement: The assembly induction, using the division theorem, constructs all triangular identities and the full ordered basis.

C_EGH_HILBERT_REDUCTION.statement: The commuting-form construction implies the EGH Hilbert-function conclusion and its characteristic-zero extension.

C_LPP_TRANSFER.statement: The full commuting-form basis transfers resolutions and permits a Hilbert-matching monomial ideal with no smaller Betti numbers.

C_LPP_MONOMIAL_COMPARISON.statement: The companion's monomial stabilization and box comparison give the lex-plus-powers Betti inequalities.

C_DIA_DIVISION.statement: Under every hypothesis of thm:division, including arbitrary permitted block characters and the generic fields K and F, ind(Delta)=deg(Delta)=e0*e1.

C_DIA_PARAMETERS.statement: thm:parameters gives geometric integrality, the stated singular-codimension bound, smooth h-dimensional linear sections, and (M+2h)-connectivity of the smooth punctured cone.

C_DIA_CURVE_DATA.statement: The prescribed curve is a connected etale G-cover with a genuinely linearized degree-|G| line bundle, generic section rank |G|, a free Pic^1 action, and equivariant circle maps for all required characters.

C_DIA_TWISTED_EXTENSION.statement: The generic Morita module has rank e0*r and extends coherently with the associative Hom-line-corrected transport and commuting Delta0 action.

C_DIA_DETERMINANT_DESCENT.statement: The determinant correction has universal-line scalar weights (-1,0), cancels the Morita transport cocycle, and gives genuine H-equivariance after derived restriction to R=0.

C_DIA_PICARD_PAIRING.statement: The mixed determinant line on B times P extracts the rank of every K-class pulled back from B, up to a fixed sign.

C_DIA_TORSOR_EULER.statement: Pullback through a finite constant-group torsor of projective schemes multiplies the Euler characteristic of every coherent class by the torsor degree.

C_DIA_RANK_EULER.statement: prop:rank-to-euler gives the genuine equivariant Delta0-module class beta with fiber index plus or minus r and twist indices chi/e0 in e0*e1*Z.

C_DIA_EQUIVARIANT_MAP.statement: The cone connectivity and Pic^1 character maps give the equivariant projective test and the nonequivariant homotopies used to compare a smooth linear section.

C_DIA_K_PUSHFORWARD.statement: Integration with the Todd class along a smooth projective variety over projective h-space is the Chern character of a unique integral K-class.

C_DIA_INDEX_TEST.statement: prop:index-test produces q_j in e1*Z with q_0=plus or minus r and all complete-intersection twist indices in e0*e1*Z.

C_DIA_PADIC.statement: For prime p, v>=1, ord_u(A mod p)=nu, h>=v*nu and AQ=0 modulo (p^v,u^(h+1)) imply p^v divides Q(0), including nu=0.

C_DIA_ARITHMETIC.statement: The complete-intersection Hilbert series and the exact prime-power truncation lemma force e0 to divide Q_*(0), hence e0*e1 divides every module's reduced rank.

C_DIA_FORMAL_CORE.statement: Over any commutative ring, p^v=0 and the truncated Bezout identity X^nu=A*D+C(p)*T modulo X^(h+1), together with X^(h+1) dividing A*Q and nu*v<=h, force Q(0)=0.

C_DIA_BEZOUT.statement: If A modulo prime p has exact order nu at zero, a finite inverse of its unit factor constructs an integral truncated Bezout identity X^nu=A*D+p*T+X^(h+1)*U for every h>=nu.

C_DIA_GENERAL_BRIDGE.statement: For any constant connected etale finite-group cover of a positive-genus curve and genuinely linearized degree-|G| line, the same generic construction has degree e0*|H| and every finite module of reduced rank r produces q_j in |H|*Z, q_0=plus or minus r, whose complete-intersection twist indices are in e0*|H|*Z.

C_DIA_GENERAL_COVER.statement: Keeping the same U,W,b,h,M, arbitrary characters and generic fields, replace the binary curve by any constant connected etale G-cover of a smooth positive-genus curve and take any genuinely G-linearized degree-|G| line. The Picard-transport coefficient algebra has index e0*|G|^(M-1).
